name: std::isdigit
intro:
Checks if the given character is one of the 10 decimal digits: (0123456789).

The behavior is undefined if the value of ch is not representable as unsigned char and is not equal to EOF.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero value if the character is a numeric character, zero otherwise.

sections.title: Notes

summary: Checks if the given character is one of the 10 decimal digits: (0123456789).
